description: This file defines a MapStruct mapper interface for converting SearchedExternalAssetOwner objects into ExternalTransferData objects, including various helper methods for mapping specific fields.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerSearchDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for transforming SearchedExternalAssetOwner objects into ExternalTransferData objects with custom field mappings.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a SearchedExternalAssetOwner object to ExternalTransferData, applying specific field mappings and ignoring previousOwner.

methods.name: toTransferExternalId
methods.description: Extracts the transfer external ID value from SearchedExternalAssetOwner.

methods.name: toLoanExternalId
methods.description: Creates ExternalTransferLoanData from SearchedExternalAssetOwner's loan ID and external loan ID.

methods.name: toOwner
methods.description: Creates ExternalTransferOwnerData from the owner information in SearchedExternalAssetOwner.

methods.name: toDetails
methods.description: Creates ExternalTransferDataDetails from various fields in SearchedExternalAssetOwner, or returns null if detailsId is null.

calls: new ExternalTransferDataDetails(source.getDetailsId(), source.getTotalOutstanding(), source.getPrincipalOutstanding(), source.getInterestOutstanding(), source.getFeeOutstanding(), source.getPenaltyOutstanding(), source.getTotalOverpaid())
